branch.title: Quantum Resource Theory Network (QRT-Net v1.2)
branch.notes: Five native layers folded into three: model/process_cptp -> M; state -> S; witness/task -> O. Node roles kept as sub-layers (free/resource/dist; free_ops/use_ops/no_ops; detector/quantifier).

extra.statement: A quantum resource theory is a pair (F, O): free states F and free operations O with the golden rule O(F) subset of F. The maximal class is RNG (resource non-generating). Theories are classified by how O is justified physically.
F convex and closed. Then every resource state is separated from F by a hyperplane: witnesses exist, and the generalized robustness R(rho) = min{s : (rho + s sigma)/(1+s) in F} is well defined.
F closed under tensor products and partial trace (symmetric monoidal structure of Coecke-Fritz-Spekkens). Prerequisite for asymptotic (many-copy) rates.

For F satisfying the Brandao-Plenio axioms, the Stein exponent of resource testing equals the regularized relative entropy of resource; consequence: asymptotic reversibility under asymptotically resource-non-generating operations, with the regularized relative entropy as the unique 'entropy'. History: claimed 2010, proof gap found 2023 (Berta et al., Quantum 7, 1103 (2023) [verify page]), proven 2024.

In any convex QRT, every resource state strictly outperforms all free states in some (sub)channel discrimination task, and the generalized robustness is the exact maximal advantage. Extended beyond convexity via multi-copy discrimination.
refs: Takagi, Regula, Bu, Liu, Adesso, PRL 122, 140402 (2019) [verified]
Kuroiwa, Takagi, Adesso, Yamasaki, 'Every quantum helps' [verify venue]

extra.statement: DERIVED classification. The 12 proper theories split by the physical justification of O: symmetry-type (asymmetry; unspeakable coherence; imaginarity as antiunitary Z2 analogue), subtheory-type (magic, CV non-Gaussianity), partition-type (entanglement, steering, nonlocality, contextuality, incompatibility), constraint-type (purity, athermality). Athermality is the unique two-type intersection, mirrored at state level (unique free state = the one symmetric Gibbs state) and witness level (second laws factor into free-energy + coherence families).
refs: classification assembled here; cf. Chitambar, Gour, RMP 91, 025001 (2019) [knowledge]

extra.statement: Intersection classes (local quantum-incoherent operations and classical communication): the arena in which entanglement and coherence are interconverted and assisted-distilled.

Catalysts enlarge the reachable set in many theories: entanglement catalysis (Jonathan-Plenio), catalytic coherence (Aberg), catalytic thermodynamics; a cross-theory phenomenon of the operations layer and a candidate route around exact-RNG irreversibility (entanglement battery, QG9).
refs: Datta, Kondra, Miller, Streltsov, Rep. Prog. Phys. 86, 116002 (2023) [verified]

extra.statement: NE (entanglement), MIO (coherence), GPO (athermality), CSPO-type (magic), covariant (asymmetry), unital (purity). Reversibility statements live here and are class-sensitive: exact vs asymptotic non-generation is the load-bearing distinction.
Convexity + closedness of F implies every resource state is detected by some linear witness. The convexity axiom translated to the witness layer.

Generalized robustness is exactly the maximal advantage of a resource state over all free states in a class of subchannel discrimination tasks - one witness/task pair that every convex theory instantiates.
The universal task: every resource of every convex theory buys a strict advantage here; steering's version is subchannel discrimination with 1W-LOCC measurements.
Constraint-type model: the only free state is the maximally mixed one; free ops = noisy operations; state pre-order = majorization; equivalent to athermality with trivial Hamiltonian.

Constraint x symmetry type: energy conservation (U(1)-covariance of TO) + unique full-rank fixed point gamma (Gibbs preservation). Block-diagonal sector governed by thermomajorization; coherent sector by asymmetry theory. The unique two-axiom intersection of the typology (QP1).
Symmetry-type: group G acts by a unitary representation; free = invariant states; O = covariant channels. Monotone set strictly larger than speakable-coherence monotone set.

F = fixed points of the dephasing map Delta. Free-op zoo MIO > {IO, DIO} > SIO reflects the absence of a single physical justification (Marvian-Spekkens critique); TIO < DIO is the symmetry-justified subclass.

Z2 analogue of coherence with respect to an ANTIUNITARY (complex conjugation K): free = K-invariant states. Not a G-covariance theory in the usual sense because K is not a channel; free ops defined by real Kraus operators.
Subtheory-type: the stabilizer subtheory is classically simulable; resource = whatever lies outside its convex hull. Odd d: distillation-relevant boundary characterized by discrete-Wigner positivity.
Subtheory-type CV twin of magic: Gaussian subtheory simulable; Wigner negativity is the resource for CV quantum-computational advantage (positive Wigner implies efficient classical simulation).
Partition-type: spatially separated labs; O = LOCC (classical communication allowed). Maximal class NE (non-entangling).
Partition-type with asymmetric trust: one characterized (trusted) and one uncharacterized wing; O = one-way LOCC from the trusted wing.
Partition-type with no communication: resources are common-cause boxes; O = the polytope of LOSR wirings; classical/nonclassical defined by the causal model required.
Partition-type over compatibility structures: behaviors on measurement scenarios; O = noncontextual wirings; unifies KS contextuality and Bell nonlocality in one framework.
refs: Amaral, Cabello, Terra Cunha, Aolita, PRL 120, 130403 (2018) [verified]

extra.statement: Resource on measurement DEVICES, not states: incompatibility = quantum programmability of a classical-output device; complete convertibility conditions via discrimination with post-measurement information. Shows the QRT schema extends to dynamical objects.

FAILS two framework axioms: (i) the classical-state set is non-convex; (ii) local channels can create discord, so no golden-rule free-op class contains even local processing. Discord quantities remain meaningful but discord is not a QRT in the standard sense.
The free set is the single state I/d - the smallest free set in the compilation, making purity the bottom currency: every other theory's free set contains it.
Any rho != I/d is a resource. Pre-order: majorization (complete); asymptotic rate log d - S(rho); fully reversible with no bound resources - the benchmark reversible theory.
Unique free state e^{-beta H}/Z: the only state that is both a fixed point of the Gibbs constraint AND U(1)-symmetric - the state-level shadow of the two-axiom intersection (QP1).
Any rho != gamma. Block-diagonal sector ordered by thermomajorization; coherent sector constrained independently by asymmetry modes (neither family alone complete).
U_g rho U_g^dag = rho for all g. For U(1) generated by H with nondegenerate spectrum: exactly the energy-incoherent states.
[rho, H] != 0 for translations: unspeakable coherence. Quantified by the QFI family; pure-state asymmetry not captured by any single entropic measure.
Diagonal in the fixed reference basis: Delta(rho) = rho.
Off-diagonal in the fixed basis; golden unit |+_d>. Every coherent state is distillable at rate C_r under IO - no bound coherence exists.
Density matrices with real entries in the fixed basis (invariant under conjugation K).
States with nonzero imaginary parts; golden unit (|0> + i|1>)/sqrt(2); qubit and pure-state conversion fully solved.
Convex hull of stabilizer states; classically simulable (Gottesman-Knill). Contains maximally entangled states (Bell, GHZ): free-of-magic is not free-of-entanglement.
Outside STAB; golden unit T state. Odd d: mana > 0 iff discrete-Wigner-negative; Wigner-positive non-stabilizer states are BOUND magic (undistillable).
Nonnegative CV Wigner function (resp. convex hull of Gaussians); positive-Wigner dynamics is classically simulable.
Negativity of the CV Wigner function; golden unit Fock |1>; necessary for CV computational advantage and equivalent to CV contextuality.
refs: Booth, Chabaud, Emeriau, PRL 129, 230401 (2022) [knowledge, verified in prior network run]

extra.statement: Convex mixtures of product states. Deciding membership is NP-hard; witnesses complete by Hahn-Banach.
Outside SEP; golden unit ebit |Phi+>. E_D < E_C in general: bound entangled (PPT) states have E_D = 0 < E_C.
Assemblages admitting local-hidden-state models. Strictly between the neighbors: SEP < unsteerable < Bell-local, both inclusions strict (Werner ranges).
No LHS model. Steering requires BOTH entanglement of the state and incompatibility of the untrusted measurements, jointly.
Common-cause boxes explained by a classical causal model. Caveat QP2: the STATE-level Bell-local set is not tensor-stable (superactivation); boxes under LOSR, not states, are the proper free objects.
Boxes violating some Bell inequality; every convexly extremal quantumly realizable box is at the top of the quantum LOSR pre-order; the PR box is the beyond-quantum top.
Behaviors with noncontextual models on the scenario's compatibility structure. Bell-local behaviors are the special case where contexts are spacelike (SS15).
Violate some noncontextuality inequality; maximally contextual boxes ('contextuality bits') exist for broad scenario classes.
POVM collections with a parent measurement - equivalently, devices programmable with classical programs.
refs: Heinosaari, Miyadera, Ziman, J. Phys. A 49, 123001 (2016) [knowledge]

extra.statement: No parent POVM. In one-to-one correspondence with steerable assemblages (SS10); golden unit: mutually unbiased sharp pair.
Diagonal in a product basis; locally broadcastable. The set is NON-CONVEX: mixing CC states of different bases is discordant - the convexity-axiom violation (MM9).
Any state not classical-classical, separable states included. Relative entropy of quantumness = minimal distillable entanglement generated by the activation protocol.

Member of every free set considered here EXCEPT purity, where it is the unique free state, and athermality, where it is free only at infinite temperature (trivial H). The universal bottom of all pre-orders.

Unique athermality-free state; incoherent in the energy basis (nondegenerate H); U(1)-symmetric; real in the energy basis; separable for noninteracting local H. But for a generic interacting H, gamma is NOT a stabilizer state: the thermal state of one theory is a magic resource of another (QP5).
Stabilizer and real and pure: free in magic and imaginarity, maximal resource in coherence (basis Z), purity, and U(1)-asymmetry (H prop Z). Witnesses that coherence is NOT sufficient for magic.
(|0> + e^{i pi/4}|1>)/sqrt(2): simultaneously a resource of magic, coherence, purity AND imaginarity; injection yields the T gate and universality.
Odd d: states outside STAB yet with mana = 0; useless for magic distillation and classically simulable - the magic analogue of bound entanglement.

Maximally entangled, maximally steering-capable, Bell-violating (with incompatible measurements) - yet a stabilizer state (magic-free) and real (imaginarity-free). Shows STAB is not inside SEP: free sets of different theories cut across each other.

Entangled for p > 1/3; admit LHV models for projective measurements in a range (Werner) and even for POVMs (Barrett); unsteerable range (WJD). The canonical witness that SEP < unsteerable < Bell-local is strict.
PPT entangled: E_D = 0 < E_C. Some bound entangled states violate Bell inequalities (Peres conjecture false): nonlocality without distillability.
Separable (entanglement-free) yet discordant; the input class for discord-to-entanglement activation.
Noisy operations (unitaries + maximally mixed ancillas + partial trace); unital maps give the same single-system state pre-order (majorization).

Purity as fuel: kT ln2 of work per pure bit (Landauer/Szilard); and via free unitaries it converts into maximal coherence in any chosen basis, which bounds downstream entanglement and discord generation (QP4 cascade).
refs: Streltsov, Kampermann, Wolk, Gessner, Bruss, NJP 20, 053058 (2018) [verified]

extra.statement: Energy-conserving unitaries + Gibbs ancillas: Gibbs-preserving AND U(1)-covariant. Strictly inside GPO: a Gibbs-preserving map can create energy coherence while TO cannot. Whether TO = GPO intersect TIO exactly is open here (QG2).

Spending athermality: single-shot deterministic work set by min-free-energy; the F_alpha second laws govern which conversions TO can perform; correlations (incl. entanglement) carry extra extractable work beyond the marginals.

Impossible even with resources: coherence distillation machines do not exist - under thermal/covariant processing the distillable coherence of every full-rank state is ZERO even with unlimited work, while the coherence cost equals the QFI; and work stored in coherence is locked - not extractable without an external phase reference.
Channels commuting with the group action. For U(1) time translations: TIO, strictly inside DIO (group averaging implements dephasing covariance).

Spending asymmetry: phase-estimation precision = QFI (an asymmetry monotone); clock synchronization and reference-frame alignment consume it; catalytic coherence (Aberg) permits repeated use of one coherent battery.
SIO subset of IO and DIO; IO, DIO subset of MIO; TIO subset of DIO; IO and DIO incomparable. MIO = maximal (RNG) class.

Spending coherence: every coherent state distills |+> at rate C_r under IO; dilution from |+> costs C_f; coherent inputs power what incoherent ones cannot - e.g. entanglement generation via bipartite IO (C1).

Impossible even with resources: under IO, C_f > C_r for generic mixed states, so distill-then-dilute cannot return the input at par. Reversibility holds only under asymptotically resource-non-generating (MIO-type) operations at rate C_r (Stein-lemma regime).
Channels with real Kraus operators; local real ops + classical communication (LRCC) define the distributed theory.

Spending imaginarity: real orthogonal pure-state pairs that LOCC distinguishes perfectly become indistinguishable (no better than guessing in the worst case) when one party is restricted to real operations - the imaginary resource buys the gap.
Stabilizer protocols (Clifford unitaries, Pauli measurements, stabilizer ancillas, feed-forward) subset of completely stabilizer-preserving operations (channel-maximal class for simulation bounds).
refs: Seddon, Campbell, Proc. R. Soc. A 475, 20190251 (2019) [verify]

extra.statement: Spending magic: T-state injection promotes stabilizer circuits to universal quantum computation; robustness of magic prices the classical-simulation overhead of the spent states.

Impossible even with resources: Wigner-positive magic states cannot be distilled by stabilizer operations (bound magic); and equal-mana state classes exist that do NOT interconvert at unit rate - magic is asymptotically irreversible under STAB ops.
Gaussian unitaries, Gaussian measurements, feed-forward; cannot create Wigner negativity.
Spending Wigner negativity: injected into Gaussian circuits it lifts them beyond efficient classical simulation - the CV analogue of magic injection.
Local operations + classical communication; the ladder continues upward through separable, PPT-preserving and non-entangling operations, each step changing which states count as equivalent.

Spending ebits: teleportation and dense coding consume maximal entanglement; distillation protocols concentrate noisy entanglement; every entangled state wins some semiquantum game (Buscemi) - a measurement-device-independent certificate that all entanglement is usable.

nodes.label: No second law (exact NE); bound ENT

extra.statement: Impossible even with resources: under EXACTLY non-entangling operations, entanglement manipulation is asymptotically irreversible - no single measure governs all transformations, so no axiomatic second law; and bound entangled states cannot be distilled by LOCC at all (E_D = 0 < E_C).
Local ops + one-way classical communication from the trusted party: the free operations that cannot create steering.

Spending steering: one-sided device-independent key distribution is secured exactly by steerability; steering = advantage in subchannel discrimination restricted to 1W-LOCC measurements (Piani-Watrous).
The free operations on common-cause boxes form a polytope; convertibility between boxes is decidable by linear programming.

Spending nonlocality: Bell violation certifies device-independent keys and randomness; and tensoring + local measurements SUPERACTIVATES hidden nonlocality - k copies of some Bell-local entangled states jointly violate a Bell inequality (Palazuelos).
Explicit parametrized class of contextuality-free operations on behaviors; forms a convex set; restricted to Bell scenarios NCW is NOT the same operation set as LOSR (P6).
Spending contextuality: preparation contextuality powers parity-oblivious multiplexing beyond any noncontextual bound; contextual fraction quantifies the advantage.
refs: Spekkens, Buzacott, Keehn, Toner, Pryde, PRL 102, 010401 (2009) [verify]

extra.statement: Compatibility-non-decreasing maps on devices: quantum pre-processing by a channel + classical post-processing of outcomes.

Spending incompatibility: every incompatible set strictly beats all compatible ones in some state-discrimination game with post-measurement information; the game family is COMPLETE for the convertibility pre-order.

Golden-rule failure: a local channel acting on one share of a classical-classical state can CREATE discord, so no free-operation class containing even local processing exists - the operations-layer pathology that disqualifies discord as a standard QRT.

Spending discord: local CNOT interactions with ancillas map any discordant state (separable included) to one with distillable system-ancilla entanglement; REQ = the minimal entanglement so generated. Also: discord = minimal entanglement created between system and apparatus in a measurement.
Tr rho^2 > 1/d, or any measurement statistics deviating from uniform - the simplest witness in the compilation.
log d - S(rho) and the Renyi nonuniformity family; majorization is a COMPLETE monotone family - detection and quantification coincide here.
Deviation from Gibbs statistics; operationally, any positive extractable work certifies athermality.

The Renyi free energies F_alpha (complete on block-diagonal states) PLUS the asymmetry-mode monotones for coherences: two families, jointly complete, separately incomplete - the witness-level image of the two-axiom model (QP1).
Any noninvariance of outcome statistics under the group action; mode-resolved tomography detects which asymmetry modes are populated.
Quantum Fisher information is an asymmetry monotone; Mandelstam-Tamm and Margolus-Levitin speed limits are asymmetry bounds; under thermal covariant processing QFI is exactly the coherence COST.
Robustness of coherence is directly measurable via witness-based lower bounds and interferometric visibility.
Relative entropy of coherence C_r (= distillable), coherence of formation C_f (= cost), l1-norm, robustness (= discrimination advantage, W2 instance).
Operational witness: the discrimination gap that appears when one party is restricted to real operations; realized in optical experiments.
Robustness of imaginarity and geometric imaginarity; pure-state and qubit conversion fully characterized by them.
Mana > 0 (odd d), robustness > 1, stabilizer-fidelity thresholds: each certifies nonstabilizerness.
Mana (additive, odd d), robustness of magic (prices classical-simulation overhead), stabilizer extent - quantifiers tied to distillation and simulation bounds.
Displaced-parity measurements reconstruct W(alpha) point by point; any measured negative value certifies the resource.
Monotone under Gaussian protocols; bounds the cost of classical simulation of CV circuits.
Linear witnesses are complete for the convex SEP set (Hahn-Banach); PPT is a one-sided criterion; deciding separability is NP-hard.

Distillable entanglement, entanglement cost, relative entropy of entanglement, negativity, robustness. The E_D < E_C gap on bound states is the single-shot face of the irreversibility formalized in pX-ent.
SDP membership tests for LHS models; steering inequalities import one-to-one from joint-measurability (incompatibility) criteria.
Steering robustness equals the advantage in subchannel discrimination with 1W-LOCC measurements - the steering instance of the universal robustness theorem.
Facet Bell-inequality violations certify nonclassicality of the common cause.
The information in the degrees of violation of ALL facet Bell inequalities does NOT determine the LOSR pre-order: quantification strictly exceeds witnessing in this theory.
Scenario inequalities; the contextual fraction detects and grades violation.
An NCW-monotone (the completeness question for a monotone family under NCW is open territory, cf. QG3).
Detection via steering (SS10), via noise robustness thresholds, and via discrimination advantages.
State discrimination with post-measurement information yields a COMPLETE monotone family: it decides convertibility of programmable devices, not just detection.
A state is locally broadcastable iff it has zero discord; operational failure of local broadcasting witnesses discord.
Quantum discord; relative entropy of quantumness = minimal distillable entanglement generated by activation - a quantifier with an entanglement-denominated operational meaning.
Unspeakable coherence w.r.t. the eigenbasis of an observable = asymmetry under the translation group it generates; the asymmetry theory (TIO for U(1)) is the physically justified coherence theory.

Speakable coherence (IO/MIO) is NOT asymmetry: measures of speakable coherence are a proper subset of measures of asymmetry; IO and TIO are inequivalent classes and the IO/MIO framework lacks a symmetry justification.

Athermality = constraint (Gibbs preservation) x symmetry (U(1)-covariance): its second-law constraints factor into free-energy monotones (block-diagonal data) + asymmetry-mode constraints (coherences); neither family alone is complete.
Trivial Hamiltonian limit: Gibbs -> I/d, thermal ops -> noisy ops; purity/nonuniformity is athermality with H proportional to I.
Imaginarity is the Z2/antiunitary analogue of coherence (free = conjugation-invariant vs dephasing-invariant); it is NOT a G-covariance theory because complex conjugation is not a channel.
CV/DV twins: in odd d, mana(rho) = 0 iff discrete-Wigner-positive; in CV, Wigner positivity defines the simulable free cone. Same quasiprobability mechanism, different phase spaces.

One ladder, three theories: tightening LOCC to 1W-LOCC gives steering, to LOSR gives nonlocality. LOCC is the WRONG free-op class for Bell scenarios; LOSR-entanglement is the resource relevant to nonlocality.
refs: Schmid, Selby, Wolfe, Spekkens, arXiv:1911.12462 [verify published venue]

extra.statement: Bell scenarios are contextuality scenarios with spacelike contexts; NCW give a unified resource framework. Caveat: NCW restricted to Bell scenarios is NOT equivalent to LOSR (P6).
The set of classical-classical states is non-convex (mixing classical states of different bases yields discordant states): the convexity axiom fails for discord.
Golden-rule failure: local channels can create discord from classical states, so no free-op class containing local processing exists.

Second law restored: under ASYMPTOTICALLY resource-non-generating operations every theory meeting the Brandao-Plenio axioms is reversible, with unique rate function = regularized relative entropy of resource (generalized quantum Stein lemma, proven 2024 after the 2023 gap).

The entanglement no-go coexists with the Stein-lemma second law: irreversibility holds under EXACT non-generation, reversibility under ASYMPTOTIC non-generation. The exact/asymptotic frontier is the load-bearing hinge (QG4).

The advantage axiom instantiates as the robustness-discrimination theorem in every convex theory, and survives (multi-copy form) without convexity - so even discord-type quantumness retains an operational-advantage reading.
Incompatibility shows the schema extends from states to devices: free objects are classically programmable devices; complete convertibility conditions exist (guessing games).
Free-set containment: states incoherent in a local PRODUCT basis are diagonal in a product basis, hence separable - INC(product basis) is a strict subset of SEP.
refs: elementary; cf. Streltsov, Adesso, Plenio, RMP 89, 041003 (2017) [knowledge]

extra.statement: I/d is the unique purity-free state and lies in every other free set here (SEP, incoherent, symmetric, real, STAB, Wigner-positive); in athermality it is free only for trivial H.

QP5 (thermal magic): the Gibbs state of a generic interacting Hamiltonian is NOT in STAB - thermal states generically carry magic while being free for athermality, coherence (energy basis), asymmetry and imaginarity. Free-of-one, resource-of-another in a single physical state.
refs: proof sketch in catalog; no dedicated literature located - flagged as gap QG5

extra.statement: Gamma is the unique free state of athermality, and simultaneously a member of the free sets of coherence (energy basis), asymmetry (U(1)) and imaginarity (energy basis).
|+> is a stabilizer state and real: magic-free and imaginarity-free. Hence coherence is NOT sufficient for magic.
|+> is the maximal coherence resource (basis Z), a maximal purity resource, and a U(1)-asymmetry resource (H prop Z) - while sitting inside the magic and imaginarity free sets (SS4).

|Phi+> is a stabilizer state and real: maximal entanglement with zero magic and zero imaginarity. STAB is not contained in SEP and SEP is not contained in STAB: free sets cut across one another (SS13).
|Phi+> is the golden unit of entanglement: maximally entangled, maximally steering-capable, Bell-violating with incompatible measurements.

Entangled Werner states admit LHV models (projective: Werner 1989; all POVMs: Barrett 2002) and unsteerable ranges (WJD 2007): entangled yet inside the Bell-local and LHS free sets - the strictness witness for the whole hierarchy.
Some PPT bound entangled states violate a Bell inequality (Peres conjecture false): nonlocality without distillable entanglement.
Bound magic: Wigner-positive non-stabilizer states (odd d) are magic resources by set membership yet undistillable and classically simulable.
The T state is simultaneously a resource of magic, coherence, purity AND imaginarity - a maximal multi-theory resource on one qubit; its injection yields universality (pU-mag).
One-to-one mapping: every steering problem is a joint-measurability problem and vice versa; steering monotones double as incompatibility monotones.

QP2: at the level of quantum STATES, the Bell-local set is not closed under tensor products - superactivation makes k copies of a local entangled state nonlocal. The tensor axiom fails for state-level locality; resolution: the proper objects are boxes under LOSR, where closure holds.

{gamma} is a subset of the incoherent states (energy basis, nondegenerate H): the athermality free set sits inside the coherence free set - any free transformation of coherence theory leaves gamma free.

Transversality: STAB is NOT a subset of SEP (Bell state is stabilizer and entangled) and SEP is NOT a subset of STAB (the product state T tensor |0> is separable and magic). Neither theory's free transformations respect the other's free set.

Incoherent states are real in the same basis (diagonal entries are probabilities): INC is a strict subset of the real states, so every free state of coherence is also free for imaginarity - but not conversely (real off-diagonal states).

Bell-local behaviors are exactly the noncontextual behaviors of Bell-type scenarios (spacelike contexts): the nonlocality free set embeds in the contextuality free set scenario-by-scenario. Operations caveat: NCW restricted to Bell scenarios differs from LOSR (P6).
SEP is a strict subset of the unsteerable states: every separable state admits an LHS model by construction; strictness by unsteerable entangled Werner states.
Unsteerable is a strict subset of Bell-local: an LHS model is an LHV model with quantum states on one wing; strictness by steerable yet Bell-local states.
State-level identification: U(1)-symmetric = incoherent in the (nondegenerate) energy eigenbasis. The free sets coincide; the MONOTONE sets do not (MM2) - same states, different theories.
Discordant separable states: inside the SEP free set of entanglement, yet discord resources - the inputs that the activation protocol (pU-dis) converts into distillable entanglement.

Faithful conversion: a state can be turned into an entangled one by incoherent operations iff it is coherent; max entanglement generated defines coherence monotones; E_r(output) <= C_r(input), achievable (generalized CNOT).
refs: Streltsov, Singh, Dhar, Bera, Adesso, PRL 115, 020403 (2015) [verified]

extra.statement: Assisted frameworks: shared entanglement is consumed to create or localize coherence on the incoherent side; entanglement and coherence become interconvertible currencies in the intersection class p-lqicc.
refs: Chitambar, Streltsov, Rana, Bera, Adesso, Lewenstein, PRL 116, 070402 (2016) [verify author list]

extra.statement: Purity = maximal coherence achievable by unitaries (distance-based quantifiers coincide exactly); purity also upper-bounds the entanglement and discord producible by global unitaries - the P >= C_max >= E_max cascade (QP4).
refs: Streltsov, Kampermann, Wolk, Gessner, Bruss, NJP 20, 053058 (2018) [verified]

extra.statement: Energy coherence is an athermality resource not captured by free energy: coherence modes evolve under independent constraints, coherence transfer manifests irreversibility beyond free energy, and work is locked in coherence (pX-ath).

The asymmetry resource feeds the no-go: coherence cost of ANY state under thermal processing = its QFI; distillable coherence = 0 for all full-rank states. The asymmetry sector of thermodynamics is maximally irreversible.

Activation: every nonclassically correlated (discordant) state, including separable ones, generates distillable entanglement with ancillas; relative entropy of quantumness = minimal distillable entanglement so generated.
extra.via: local CNOT/measurement interaction with ancillas, then entanglement distillation (pU-dis)

extra.statement: Entanglement is necessary for Bell violation; insufficient per copy (Werner/Barrett local models); but superactivatable: many copies of some Bell-local entangled states violate Bell inequalities. Every entangled state wins some semiquantum game (Buscemi).
extra.via: local incompatible measurements (single copy); tensoring + local measurements (superactivation)

extra.statement: Strict hierarchy: steerable implies entangled, Bell-nonlocal implies steerable; both converses fail (Werner ranges). Steering requires BOTH entanglement (sR-ent) and incompatibility (sR-inc) jointly.
extra.via: incompatible measurements on the untrusted wing

extra.statement: Contextuality is necessary and (for odd prime d) sufficient for magic-state distillability: nonzero mana implies KS-contextuality w.r.t. stabilizer measurements. Multiqubit case obstructed by state-independent contextuality (QG1).
refs: Howard, Wallman, Veitch, Emerson, Nature 510, 351 (2014) [knowledge, verified in prior network run]
extra.via: stabilizer measurements on the magic state

extra.statement: CV: Wigner negativity iff contextuality (continuous-variable scenario), closing the CV side of the magic-contextuality correspondence.
refs: Booth, Chabaud, Emeriau, PRL 129, 230401 (2022) [knowledge, verified in prior network run]

extra.statement: Coherence is necessary for magic (every nonstabilizer state is coherent in every stabilizer eigenbasis - a stabilizer-diagonal state is a STAB mixture) but radically insufficient (|+>, SS4). No faithful conversion protocol known - QG5.
refs: 'Coherence makes quantum systems magical', arXiv:1801.04807 [verify authors/venue]
necessity: derived, proof sketch in catalog

extra.statement: Imaginarity powers local discrimination: an ENT-free task (discriminating real orthogonal product states) separates imaginarity-free from imaginarity-resourced agents - a cross-theory witness.
extra.via: LOCC with vs without local imaginarity

extra.statement: Second laws: the Renyi free energies govern deterministic work extraction and state interconversion for block-diagonal states.

Correlations store work: extractable work from correlated states exceeds that from their marginals; entanglement maximizes the single-shot gain - an entanglement resource spent in the thermodynamic task node.

Every coherent state has distillable coherence C_r > 0 under IO (no bound coherence); cost is C_f >= C_r. The resource is spent faithfully: distillation succeeds for ALL resource states - rare among the 13 theories (QP3).
The same resource hits the wall: C_f > C_r generically, so an IO distill-dilute cycle loses coherence; par is restored only under asymptotically-MIO (Stein-lemma regime, MM11).
Magic is asymptotically irreversible under stabilizer protocols: maximal-mana state classes exist that do not interconvert at unit rate; Wigner-positive magic cannot be distilled at all.

Catalysis changes the pre-order: entanglement catalysis (LOCC + returned catalyst) enables otherwise impossible pure-state conversions; catalytic coherence enables repeated coherence use; a candidate route around pX-ent via entanglement batteries (QG9).
